workarounds.symptom: Custom component: imports guarded by try/except ImportError are skipped (NameError in class body and methods)
workarounds.workaround: Fix: fix(lfx): run import-only try/except guards when building custom component scope. Target files: src/lfx/src/lfx/custom/validate.py, src/lfx/tests/unit/custom/test_guarded_imports.py. `prepare_global_scope` (`src/lfx/src/lfx/custom/validate.py`) only collected top-level `import` / `from ... import` statements. Imports inside `try/except ImportError`, the usual optional-dependency pattern, were skipped, so the guarded names were undefined: (Ref: https://github.com/langflow-ai/langflow/pull/16423)

workarounds.symptom: Filter Values raises AttributeError for ordinary text inputs
workarounds.workaround: Fix: fix: stop Filter Values crashing on ordinary text filters. Target files: src/lfx/src/lfx/components/processing/filter_data_values.py, src/backend/tests/unit/components/processing/test_filter_data_values_component.py, src/lfx/src/lfx/_assets/component_index.json. The legacy **Filter Values** component failed on every run with `AttributeError: 'str' object has no attribute 'text'`. This happened with plain text, with the default values, and with a connected Data input. The component has no replacement, so saved flows tha... (Ref: https://github.com/langflow-ai/langflow/pull/16202)

workarounds.symptom: Serialization: numpy float32/16 and pandas Series values leak NaN/Infinity past the JSON-compliance guard
workarounds.workaround: Fix: fix(serialization): sanitize nonfinite NumPy and pandas floats. Target files: src/backend/base/langflow/serialization/serialization.py, src/lfx/src/lfx/serialization/serialization.py, src/backend/tests/unit/serialization/test_serialization.py. NumPy scalars, arrays, and pandas Series now replace NaN and infinity with None in both serializers. Finite NumPy floats become native Python floats. Existing container shapes and truncation behavior stay the same. (Ref: https://github.com/langflow-ai/langflow/pull/16297)

workarounds.symptom: Parser Table templates round integer IDs in mixed numeric rows
workarounds.workaround: Fix: fix: preserve numeric column types in Parser templates. Target files: src/lfx/src/lfx/components/processing/parser.py, src/backend/base/langflow/initial_setup/starter_projects/Content Aggregator.json, src/backend/base/langflow/initial_setup/starter_projects/Document Q&A.json. Parser templates now preserve integer values when a table also contains floating-point columns. This keeps large IDs distinct and allows integer format specifiers. Tables with rows but no columns retain their existing behavior. Missing cells keep ... (Ref: https://github.com/langflow-ai/langflow/pull/16146)

workarounds.symptom: Flows not working when using celery rabitmq and redis
workarounds.workaround: Fix: fix: avoid pickling vertex component instances. Target files: src/lfx/src/lfx/graph/vertex/base.py, src/lfx/tests/unit/graph/vertex/test_vertex_base.py. by making `Vertex.__getstate__()` drop the live `custom_component` instance before graph state serialization. Runtime component objects can hold unserializable state, so keeping them in the pickled vertex state can break distributed execution. The graph still keeps the component metadata/configuration; only the live runtime instance is cleared from the pickle state. (Ref: https://github.com/langflow-ai/langflow/pull/13172)
